messages:
kevin_sales: Heads up — StellarApps POC seeing 403s on /v1/chat and sporadic 429s during load test. Can we triage?

kevin_sales: They sent this curl: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer stlr_poc_XYZ' -H 'X-Redwood-Org: stellar' -d '{\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"hello\"}]}'```

kevin_sales: Response: `{\"error\":\"permission_denied\",\"message\":\"key bound to tenant mismatch\"}` and sometimes `{\"error\":\"rate_limited\",\"retry_after\":2}`.

nina_se: Ask them to confirm X-Redwood-Project header and the exact project name used when they created the key. Also confirm key type (service vs demo).

kevin_sales: They say they didn't set X-Redwood-Project. Thought org header was sufficient for POC.

sam_sre: I can check control-plane bindings and auth logs. @ops-bot, pull auth failures for key prefix "stlr_poc" from 2140000511..2140001111.

ops-bot: Queried auth index. Found 12 events: 9 permission_denied (project-binding), 3 rate_limited. Sample lines redacted.

sam_sre: Control-plane lookup: key=stlr_poc_XYZ bound_org=stellar bound_project=stellar-demo-01 key_type=service scopes=[chat,generate]

sam_sre: If they omit X-Redwood-Project or send a different project name, runtime rejects with 403.

nina_se: I'll have them include `-H 'X-Redwood-Project: stellar-demo-01'` in their requests.

kevin_sales: They tried that and some requests turned 200, but the load test still produced intermittent 429s.

sam_sre: 429s match per-key TPS hits in sandbox. We can temporarily increase the burst quota. Approve?

nina_se: Approve for the 30m demo window. Make it minimal — +30 TPS.

sam_sre: Applied sandbox_quota.bump key=stlr_poc_XYZ delta=+30 duration=30m. Monitor for new 429s.

kevin_sales: Load run shows steady 200s now. StellarApps green for the demo. Thanks!

olivia_security: Quick reminders: 1) don't paste full keys in threads (redacted in logs), 2) add a short note to the presales checklist about required X-Redwood-Project header for POC keys, and 3) consider clarifying error text to suggest the expected project name.

nina_se: I'll add a one-paragraph FAQ to the sales playbook and file a docs ticket to improve the 403 message.

kevin_sales: Closing out. Great job team :tada:
